title: Voice eval corpus manifest
description: SPEC (docs/voice/SPEC.md) WP-V0.0. One entry per eval clip. Manifests are consumed by fixtures/voice/wer.ts to compute WER + hard-slice term recall. Every clip needs a human-verified reference transcript before it counts toward the §7 kill criteria — machine-generated 'references' are not evidence.

corpus_version.description: Bump on any change to reference text or clip set so bench runs can cite an exact corpus version in the go/no-go memo.

hard_slice_tag.description: SPEC §7 / WP-V0.0 hard-slice categories — the eval slice that matters, because general-traffic WER hides regressions here.

bias_term.description: A term the BiasContext (SPEC §3.3) would have carried into the utterance — used to score per-hard-slice term recall, i.e. did the engine get THIS specific word right, not just overall WER.

term.description: Canonical form as it should appear in the hypothesis, e.g. 'Postgres', 'cursor.ai', 'Kubernetes'.

id.description: Stable slug. Referenced from bench run logs and the §7 go/no-go memo — do not renumber once real audio is attached.

audio_path.description: Path relative to fixtures/voice/, e.g. 'audio/proper-noun-01.wav'. 16 kHz mono PCM WAV to match LocalAsr::feed_pcm (SPEC 3.3) directly, no resample step in the bench loop. MUST NOT exist yet for placeholder:true entries — see README.

reference_text.description: Human-verified ground truth, unwrapped (one logical line). This is what WER is computed against — never an ASR draft, even a corrected one; transcribing your own reference from the model under test contaminates the eval.

hard_slice_tags.description: Zero or more. A clip can be both 'accented-en' and 'proper-noun' at once (that intersection is where local ASR is expected to hurt most).

bias_terms.description: Terms simulating what BiasContext.terms would carry for this utterance. Empty array is valid for clips that test the NO-bias baseline (bias layers off) — see README run matrix.

speaker_accent.description: Free-text label for the 'accented-en' slice, e.g. 'en-IN', 'en-NG', 'en-DE (L2)'. Omit for non-accent clips.

duration_s.description: Clip duration in seconds. Required once real audio is attached; omit on placeholders.

placeholder.description: true = no audio file exists at audio_path; this entry is a WORKED EXAMPLE of the schema + reference-text style only, and must be excluded from any real bench run (fixtures/voice/wer.ts skips placeholder:true rows). Flip to false only after a human has recorded/verified the clip and the WAV is committed.
